title: 360 Lazy Acceleration Ender Pearl Canon - White Mc (1.21.6)
description:
Hi !
Hope you liked this video. I am not the first to use this concept to make a canon but for a 360 one I only know one which was made in 1.12. Since the game has changed a lot, this new design is more compact.

The entity aligner comes from : Bread
The TNT duper and the aligner come from the TNT archives discord server (I don't know who actally designed everything)

Thanks a lot to all the members of the TNT archives discord server for their help during the conception of the canon : Intricate, Minzbaer123, jjl2, Bringeis1
